protocol.name: TimesX-ext-protocol
protocol.val_rule: most recent pre-test samples with future_end < min(test future_start), cap 32
protocol.calib_std_rule: std(ddof=0) of past_time (96 values) of the FIRST sample sorted by future_start; denominator fallback only when window std < 1e-8; never modifies pred/true

selection_rule: argmin val standardized MSE over candidates; tie -> P=1; fallback to P=1 when val < 8 (flagged)
